exercises.instruction: Что вы скажете Лоре в этих ситуациях? Используйте Would you like to ... ?

items.prompt: You want to go to the cinema tonight.  Perhaps Laura will go with you.  (go)
answers: Would you like to go to the cinema tonight?

items.prompt: You want to play tennis tomorrow.  Perhaps Laura will play too.  (play)
answers: Would you like to play tennis tomorrow?

items.prompt: You have an extra ticket for a concert next week.  Perhaps Laura will come.  (come)
answers: Would you like to come to a concert next week?

items.prompt: It’s raining and Laura is going out.  She doesn’t have an umbrella, but you have one.  (borrow)
answers: Would you like to borrow my umbrella?

options: 'Do you like to go out for a walk?'
'Would you like to go out for a walk?'

I’d like tomatoes, but I don’t eat them very often.

What time would you like to have dinner this evening?

I’d like to go to sleep now.

'What kind of music would you like?'

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя I’d like, would you like, do you like и т. д. (рассказать историю = tell a story; снимки с отпуска = snaps from the holiday; на завтрак = for breakfast). Обратите внимание на ситуацию: в кафе и в гостях нужно would you like, а про вкусы — do you like.

answers: Would you like a glass of water?

items.prompt: (в кафе) Я хочу два кофе, пожалуйста.
answers: I’d like two coffees, please.
I would like two coffees, please.

items.prompt: Я хотела бы рассказать вам историю.
answers: I’d like to tell you a story.
I would like to tell you a story.

items.prompt: Хочешь увидеть мои фото с отпуска?
answers: Would you like to see my holiday photos?
Marina would like to travel.

items.prompt: А: Ты хотела бы посмотреть фильм в воскресенье?  В: Очень хотела бы!
answers: A: Would you like to watch a film on Sunday? B: I’d love to!
